title: Sad Plasma Ball
description: A glowing plasma ball with a sad cartoon face at its center sits on a purple nightstand. Bright pink, purple, and yellow energy beams radiate outward while transparent bubbles float around inside the glass sphere.
prompt: A sad cartoon face with teary eyes inside a glowing plasma globe, pink and purple energy arcs radiating outward, transparent bubbles floating inside the glass sphere, the plasma ball sitting on a purple nightstand in a dark whimsical bedroom with smiley face drawings on the wall, vibrant cartoon style, soft glowing lighting
